title: Falling/Raising BG Falling Threshold Adjustment
symptom: The user reports that the available thresholds for xDrip to start alerting on rising or falling blood glucose are only 2 or 3 mg/dl per reading, which are too high for their low-carb lifestyle. They experience steady but gradual changes in blood sugar that do not trigger alerts until reaching high or low levels, making the feature unusable.
fix: The thread discusses the possibility of adding lower threshold values, but no specific fix is implemented or stated. A maintainer suggests using additional high/low alarms as a workaround, but the user finds this inadequate. No final resolution is provided.
evidence_quote: You can add another alarm set at 6.0 and another at 6.5. Now, you will get 2 alarms before your blood glucose reaches 7.0.
